descriptions.text: Potion of Bloodlust It’s like giving yourself a PCP enema after spending the day riding the Night Train Express. Drinking this potion gives the following effects for (Constitution) seconds. Strength times two. Movement speed times two. Dexterity times .5 The Where the Fuck Am I? Who the Fuck Are You? Debuff Constitution times .5 For every crawler, NPC, or mob killed by you while this potion is active, your movement speed increases by an additional 25%.

beats.headline: Two potions, one warning
beats.text: Carl's silver Pacifist's Box, for winning a boss battle without killing the boss, holds two potions that give Mordecai pause. Don't use those, he says: the last time he saw someone drink that potion, they accidentally killed half of their party. It is a berserking potion, and its debuff means the drinker does not remember where they are or why they are fighting. Carl puts both away. He will look in the cookbook for advice that might make the potion more useful.

beats.headline: In the minifridge
beats.text: The sub is already inside Lusca, and the bridge window is about to break. Carl swaps a hob-lobber's fuse for hobgoblin pus and duct-tapes a potion bottle to it; the cookbook has a more elegant version with a different potion, and he has no idea if this will work. He tapes the bomb inside the bolted minifridge by the captain's chair. The window breaks and the babies flood the bridge; holding the stateroom door's turning wheel with one hand, he slams the detonator. Xs bloom on the map. It was the potion of bloodlust: spread through the water, it started a feeding frenzy.

beats.headline: The last one, thrown
beats.text: Running up a temple wall on Sticky Feet, Carl pulls a potion ball filled with his last potion of Bloodlust. Ping returns only an error, as if the map is blocked in this town. He stows the ball and throws a full-strength hob-lobber into the bunched mantises and nebular priests instead. Then two more mantis warriors swoop in, and he beams the berserking potion at the closer one. It slams into her back. Enraged, she yanks the head off her own sister, dives on the group below and cleaves a human priest in half.

relations.note: on her babies, through the water
